#include <string.h>

#include "si5332.h"
#include "si5332_cfg.h"
#include "bsp.h"        

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Registers / constants                                                    */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

#define REG_STATUS          0x05    
#define REG_USYS_CTRL           0x06    
#define REG_USYS_STAT           0x07    
#define REG_OE_0_5          0xB6    
#define REG_OE_6_7          0xB7    
#define REG_PD_ID           0xBA    
#define REG_PD_OMUX         0xBB    

#define USYS_READY          0x01    
#define USYS_ACTIVE         0x02    
#define USYS_NO_INPUT           0x89    

#define OE6_BIT             (1u << 1)   

#define TIMEOUT_READY_MS        20u 
#define TIMEOUT_ACTIVE_MS       500u    

#define VCO_HZ              2500000000ULL   
#define HSDIV0_HZ           100000000UL 
#define HSDIV1_HZ           125000000UL 
#define R_MAX               63u     
#define ID_N_MIN            10u     
#define ID_N_MAX            255u        
#define ID_FREQ_MAX_HZ          250000000UL 
#define ID_DEN_MAX          32767u      

#define NUM_CH              4   
#define NUM_ID              2   

#define CHK(x)  do { si5332_err_t _e = (x); if (_e != SI5332_OK) return _e; } while (0)

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Data types                                                                */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

typedef struct {
    u32 num;    
    u32 den;    
    u8  refcnt; 
} id_state_t;

typedef struct {
    u8  enabled;    
    u8  configured; 
    u8  fmt;    
    u8  src;    
    u8  rdiv;   
    u32 freq_hz;    
} ch_state_t;

typedef struct {
    u8 reg_mode;        
    u8 reg_div;     
    u8 reg_omux;        
    u8 oe_reg;      
    u8 oe_bit;      
    u8 omux_dis_bit;    
    u8 out_dis_reg;     
    u8 out_dis_bit;     
} ch_desc_t;

struct si5332_t {
    u8 isReady;     
    u8 isConfigured;    
    u8 i2cAddr;     
    void *hal_ctx;      
    si5332_i2c_write_f i2c_write;   
    si5332_i2c_read_f  i2c_read;    

    si5332_clk_src_t clk_src;   
    si5332_clk_src_t clk_src_req;   

    ch_state_t ch[NUM_CH];  
    id_state_t id[NUM_ID];  

    u8 dirty_ch;    
    u8 dirty_id;    
};

static struct si5332_t gDevice;

static const ch_desc_t gChDesc[NUM_CH] = {
    /* mode  div   omux  oe_reg      oe_bit omux_dis out_dis_reg out_dis_bit */
    { 0x7A, 0x7B, 0x25, REG_OE_0_5, 0,     0,        0xBC,       0 },   /* OUT0 / OMUX0 */
    { 0x89, 0x8A, 0x27, REG_OE_0_5, 3,     2,        0xBC,       3 },   /* OUT2 / OMUX2 */
    { 0x98, 0x99, 0x28, REG_OE_0_5, 6,     3,        0xBC,       6 },   /* OUT4 / OMUX3 */
    { 0xAC, 0xAD, 0x2A, REG_OE_6_7, 2,     5,        0xBD,       2 },   /* OUT7 / OMUX5 */
};

static const u8 gIdBase[NUM_ID] = { 0x36, 0x4E };

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Low-level                                                                 */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

static si5332_err_t reg_write(si5332_t *d, u8 addr, u8 val)
{
    u8 v = val;

    if (d->i2c_write(d->hal_ctx, d->i2cAddr, addr, &v) != SI5332_OK)
        return SI5332_E_I2C;
    return SI5332_OK;
}

static si5332_err_t reg_read(si5332_t *d, u8 addr, u8 *val)
{
    if (d->i2c_read(d->hal_ctx, d->i2cAddr, addr, val) != SI5332_OK)
        return SI5332_E_I2C;
    return SI5332_OK;
}

static si5332_err_t reg_rmw(si5332_t *d, u8 addr, u8 mask, u8 val)
{
    u8 v;

    CHK(reg_read(d, addr, &v));
    v = (u8)((v & ~mask) | (val & mask));
    return reg_write(d, addr, v);
}

static si5332_err_t reg_write16(si5332_t *d, u8 addr, u16 val)
{
    CHK(reg_write(d, addr,     (u8)((val >> 8) & 0x7F)));
    return reg_write(d, (u8)(addr + 1), (u8)(val & 0xFF));
}

static si5332_err_t write_table(si5332_t *d, const si5332_reg_t *t, u32 n)
{
    for (u32 i = 0; i < n; i++)
        CHK(reg_write(d, t[i].addr, t[i].val));
    return SI5332_OK;
}

static si5332_err_t goto_state(si5332_t *d, u8 state, u32 timeout_ms)
{
    u8 stat = 0;

    CHK(reg_write(d, REG_USYS_CTRL, state));

    for (u32 t = 0; ; t++) {
        CHK(reg_read(d, REG_USYS_STAT, &stat));
        if (stat == state)
            return SI5332_OK;
        if (t >= timeout_ms)
            break;
        bsp_uDelay(1000);
    }
    return (stat == USYS_NO_INPUT) ? SI5332_E_NO_INPUT : SI5332_E_TIMEOUT;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Math helper functions                                                     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

static void rational_approx(u64 n, u64 d, u32 max_den, u32 *out_n, u32 *out_d)
{
    u64 h2 = 0, h1 = 1; /* numerators  h(-2), h(-1) */
    u64 k2 = 1, k1 = 0; /* denominators k(-2), k(-1) */

    while (d != 0) {
        u64 a = n / d;
        u64 r = n % d;
        u64 h = a * h1 + h2;
        u64 k = a * k1 + k2;

        if (k > max_den) {
            /* k1 >= 1, since k(0) = 1 <= max_den */
            u64 as = ((u64)max_den - k2) / k1;

            if (2 * as > a) {   /* semiconvergent is better than the last convergent */
                h1 = as * h1 + h2;
                k1 = as * k1 + k2;
            }
            break;
        }
        h2 = h1;  h1 = h;
        k2 = k1;  k1 = k;
        n = d;    d = r;
    }

    *out_n = (u32)h1;
    *out_d = (u32)k1;
}

static void id_encode(u32 num, u32 den, u16 *intg, u16 *res, u16 *den_reg)
{
    u64 x = 128ULL * num;

    *intg    = (u16)(x / den);
    *res     = (u16)(x % den);
    *den_reg = (u16)den;
}

static int try_hsdiv(u32 f, u32 base, u8 *r)
{
    if (base % f != 0)
        return 0;
    u32 q = base / f;
    if (q < 1 || q > R_MAX)
        return 0;
    *r = (u8)q;
    return 1;
}

static int try_share_id(const id_state_t *id, u32 f, u8 *r)
{
    u64 a = VCO_HZ * id->den;
    u64 b = (u64)f * id->num;

    if (b == 0 || (a % b) != 0)
        return 0;
    u64 q = a / b;
    if (q < 1 || q > R_MAX)
        return 0;
    *r = (u8)q;
    return 1;
}

static si5332_err_t plan_id(u32 f, u32 *num, u32 *den, u8 *r)
{
    u64 denom = 255ULL * f;
    u64 rr = (VCO_HZ + denom - 1) / denom;  /* smallest R with N <= 255 */
    u32 n, dd;

    if (rr < 1)
        rr = 1;
    if (rr > R_MAX || (u64)f * rr > ID_FREQ_MAX_HZ)
        return SI5332_E_FREQ_UNSUPPORTED;

    rational_approx(VCO_HZ, (u64)f * rr, ID_DEN_MAX, &n, &dd);
    if (dd == 0 || (u64)n < (u64)ID_N_MIN * dd || (u64)n >= 256ULL * dd)
        return SI5332_E_FREQ_UNSUPPORTED;

    *num = n;
    *den = dd;
    *r   = (u8)rr;
    return SI5332_OK;
}

static int ch_index(si5332_out_ch_t ch)
{
    switch (ch) {
    case SI5332_OUT_0: return 0;
    case SI5332_OUT_2: return 1;
    case SI5332_OUT_4: return 2;
    case SI5332_OUT_7: return 3;
    default:           return -1;
    }
}

static int fmt_valid(si5332_out_format_t fmt)
{
    switch (fmt) {
    case SI5332_FMT_LVDS:
    case SI5332_FMT_LVDS_FAST:
    case SI5332_FMT_HCSL_50_EXT:
    case SI5332_FMT_HCSL_50_INT:
    case SI5332_FMT_HCSL_42_5_EXT:
    case SI5332_FMT_HCSL_42_5_INT:
    case SI5332_FMT_LVPECL:
        return 1;
    default:
        return 0;
    }
}

static u8 omux_sel1(u8 src)
{
    switch (src) {
    case SI5332_DIV_SRC_HSDIV0: return 0;
    case SI5332_DIV_SRC_HSDIV1: return 1;
    case SI5332_DIV_SRC_ID0:    return 5;
    case SI5332_DIV_SRC_ID1:    return 6;
    default:                    return 0;
    }
}

static int has_pending(const si5332_t *d)
{
    return d->dirty_ch || d->dirty_id || (d->clk_src_req != d->clk_src);
}

static void shadow_reset(si5332_t *d, si5332_clk_src_t src)
{
    memset(d->ch, 0, sizeof(d->ch));
    memset(d->id, 0, sizeof(d->id));

    for (int i = 0; i < NUM_CH; i++) {
        d->ch[i].fmt  = SI5332_FMT_LVDS_FAST;
        d->ch[i].rdiv = 1;
        d->ch[i].src  = SI5332_DIV_SRC_NONE;
    }
    /* OUT0: 100 MHz (HSDIV0), OUT2: 125 MHz (HSDIV1), OUT4/OUT7 switched off */
    d->ch[0].configured = 1;
    d->ch[0].src        = SI5332_DIV_SRC_HSDIV0;
    d->ch[0].freq_hz    = HSDIV0_HZ;
    d->ch[1].configured = 1;
    d->ch[1].src        = SI5332_DIV_SRC_HSDIV1;
    d->ch[1].freq_hz    = HSDIV1_HZ;

    d->clk_src     = src;
    d->clk_src_req = src;
    d->dirty_ch    = 0;
    d->dirty_id    = 0;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Commit helpers (only call in READY mode)                                 */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

static si5332_err_t write_id(si5332_t *d, int i)
{
    const u8 base = gIdBase[i];
    const u8 bit  = (u8)(1u << (5 + i));    /* ID0_DIS = 0xBA[5], ID1_DIS = 0xBA[6] */

    if (d->id[i].refcnt > 0) {
        u16 intg, res, den;

        id_encode(d->id[i].num, d->id[i].den, &intg, &res, &den);
        CHK(reg_write16(d, base,                 intg));
        CHK(reg_write16(d, (u8)(base + 2), res));
        CHK(reg_write16(d, (u8)(base + 4), den));
        return reg_rmw(d, REG_PD_ID, bit, 0);       /* switch ID on */
    }
    return reg_rmw(d, REG_PD_ID, bit, bit);         /* switch ID off */
}

static si5332_err_t write_channel(si5332_t *d, int i)
{
    const ch_desc_t  *c = &gChDesc[i];
    const ch_state_t *s = &d->ch[i];
    const u8 omux_bit = (u8)(1u << c->omux_dis_bit);
    const u8 out_bit  = (u8)(1u << c->out_dis_bit);

    CHK(reg_write(d, c->reg_mode, s->fmt));

    if (!s->configured) {
        /* switch block off */
        CHK(reg_rmw(d, REG_PD_OMUX,    omux_bit, omux_bit));
        return reg_rmw(d, c->out_dis_reg, out_bit, out_bit);
    }

    /* Complete register set (the CBPro export omits unused blocks) */
    CHK(reg_write(d, c->reg_div,  s->rdiv));
    CHK(reg_write(d, c->reg_omux, (u8)(omux_sel1(s->src) << 4)));   /* SEL0 = 0 */
    CHK(reg_rmw(d, REG_PD_OMUX,    omux_bit, 0));
    return reg_rmw(d, c->out_dis_reg, out_bit, 0);
}

static si5332_err_t oe_apply(si5332_t *d)
{
    u8 b0_5 = 0;
    u8 b6_7 = OE6_BIT;

    for (int i = 0; i < NUM_CH; i++) {
        if (!(d->ch[i].enabled && d->ch[i].configured))
            continue;
        if (gChDesc[i].oe_reg == REG_OE_0_5)
            b0_5 |= (u8)(1u << gChDesc[i].oe_bit);
        else
            b6_7 |= (u8)(1u << gChDesc[i].oe_bit);
    }
    CHK(reg_write(d, REG_OE_0_5, b0_5));
    return reg_write(d, REG_OE_6_7, b6_7);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* API                                                                       */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Public API: documented in si5332.h only. */
si5332_t* si5332_initialize(u8 i2c_addr, si5332_i2c_write_f w, si5332_i2c_read_f r, void *ctx)
{
    si5332_t *pDev = &gDevice;

    if (!w || !r)
        return 0;

    memset(pDev, 0, sizeof(*pDev));
    pDev->i2cAddr   = i2c_addr;
    pDev->i2c_write = w;
    pDev->i2c_read  = r;
    pDev->hal_ctx   = ctx;
    pDev->isReady   = 1;

    return pDev;
}

si5332_err_t si5332_init(si5332_t *pDev, si5332_clk_src_t initial_src)
{
    const si5332_reg_t *delta;
    u32 delta_len;

    if (!pDev)
        return SI5332_E_PARAM;
    if (!pDev->isReady)
        return SI5332_E_NOT_INIT;

    switch (initial_src) {
    case SI5332_CLK_SRC_XTAL_27M:
        delta = si5332_src_xtal_27m_regs;
        delta_len = si5332_src_xtal_27m_regs_len;
        break;
    case SI5332_CLK_SRC_CLKIN2_100M:
        delta = si5332_src_clkin2_100m_regs;
        delta_len = si5332_src_clkin2_100m_regs_len;
        break;
    default:
        return SI5332_E_PARAM;
    }

    pDev->isConfigured = 0;

    CHK(goto_state(pDev, USYS_READY, TIMEOUT_READY_MS));
    CHK(write_table(pDev, si5332_base_regs, si5332_base_regs_len));
    CHK(write_table(pDev, delta, delta_len));
    CHK(goto_state(pDev, USYS_ACTIVE, TIMEOUT_ACTIVE_MS));

    shadow_reset(pDev, initial_src);
    pDev->isConfigured = 1;

    return SI5332_OK;
}

/*
 * Commit sequence (implementation detail, API contract in si5332.h):
 *  1. Disable all outputs (REG_OE_0_5 / REG_OE_6_7 = 0).
 *  2. Switch the device to READY.
 *  3. If the clock source changed, write the new source's delta table.
 *  4. Write dirty MultiSynths (write_id()), then dirty channels (write_channel()).
 *  5. Switch the device to ACTIVE (PLL calibration/lock).
 *  6. Restore the output-enable state from the shadow (oe_apply()).
 */
si5332_err_t si5332_commit(si5332_t *pDev)
{
    if (!pDev)
        return SI5332_E_PARAM;
    if (!pDev->isConfigured)
        return SI5332_E_NOT_INIT;
    if (!has_pending(pDev))
        return SI5332_OK;

    /* 1. outputs off (clean stop before reprogramming) */
    CHK(reg_write(pDev, REG_OE_0_5, 0x00));
    CHK(reg_write(pDev, REG_OE_6_7, 0x00));

    /* 2. READY: input, divider and driver registers are only writable here */
    CHK(goto_state(pDev, USYS_READY, TIMEOUT_READY_MS));

    /* 3. clock source */
    if (pDev->clk_src_req != pDev->clk_src) {
        if (pDev->clk_src_req == SI5332_CLK_SRC_XTAL_27M)
            CHK(write_table(pDev, si5332_src_xtal_27m_regs, si5332_src_xtal_27m_regs_len));
        else
            CHK(write_table(pDev, si5332_src_clkin2_100m_regs, si5332_src_clkin2_100m_regs_len));
        pDev->clk_src = pDev->clk_src_req;  /* device now carries the new configuration */
    }

    /* 4. MultiSynths, then channels */
    for (int i = 0; i < NUM_ID; i++)
        if (pDev->dirty_id & (1u << i))
            CHK(write_id(pDev, i));
    for (int i = 0; i < NUM_CH; i++)
        if (pDev->dirty_ch & (1u << i))
            CHK(write_channel(pDev, i));

    /* 5. ACTIVE: PLL calibration / lock */
    CHK(goto_state(pDev, USYS_ACTIVE, TIMEOUT_ACTIVE_MS));

    /* 6. restore output enable according to shadow */
    CHK(oe_apply(pDev));

    pDev->dirty_ch = 0;
    pDev->dirty_id = 0;

    return SI5332_OK;
}

si5332_err_t si5332_set_clock_source(si5332_t *pDev, si5332_clk_src_t src)
{
    si5332_clk_src_t old;
    si5332_err_t err;

    if (!pDev)
        return SI5332_E_PARAM;
    if (!pDev->isConfigured)
        return SI5332_E_NOT_INIT;
    if (src != SI5332_CLK_SRC_XTAL_27M && src != SI5332_CLK_SRC_CLKIN2_100M)
        return SI5332_E_PARAM;

    old = pDev->clk_src;
    pDev->clk_src_req = src;

    err = si5332_commit(pDev);
    if (err == SI5332_E_NO_INPUT || err == SI5332_E_TIMEOUT) {
        /* new source does not provide a clock: revert to the old source (best effort) */
        pDev->clk_src_req = old;
        (void)si5332_commit(pDev);
    }
    return err;
}

si5332_err_t si5332_set_output_enable(si5332_t *pDev, si5332_out_ch_t ch, u8 enable)
{
    int i;

    if (!pDev)
        return SI5332_E_PARAM;
    if (!pDev->isConfigured)
        return SI5332_E_NOT_INIT;
    i = ch_index(ch);
    if (i < 0)
        return SI5332_E_PARAM;

    pDev->ch[i].enabled = enable ? 1 : 0;

    /* Takes effect immediately only if nothing is pending and the block is configured */
    if (!has_pending(pDev) && pDev->ch[i].configured) {
        const u8 bit = (u8)(1u << gChDesc[i].oe_bit);
        return reg_rmw(pDev, gChDesc[i].oe_reg, bit, enable ? bit : 0);
    }
    return SI5332_OK;
}

si5332_err_t si5332_set_output_format(si5332_t *pDev, si5332_out_ch_t ch, si5332_out_format_t fmt)
{
    int i;

    if (!pDev)
        return SI5332_E_PARAM;
    if (!pDev->isConfigured)
        return SI5332_E_NOT_INIT;
    i = ch_index(ch);
    if (i < 0 || !fmt_valid(fmt))
        return SI5332_E_PARAM;

    pDev->ch[i].fmt = (u8)fmt;
    pDev->dirty_ch |= (u8)(1u << i);
    return SI5332_OK;
}

/*
 * Implementation detail (API contract and routing order in si5332.h):
 * operates on a local working copy of the MultiSynth shadow state (tid) so
 * that the device shadow state remains unchanged if routing fails. Only on
 * success are the working copy and the new channel state written back and
 * the affected MultiSynths/channel marked dirty.
 */
si5332_err_t si5332_set_output_freq(si5332_t *pDev, si5332_out_ch_t ch, u32 freq_hz)
{
    id_state_t tid[NUM_ID];
    ch_state_t *cur;
    u8 src, r = 0;
    int i;

    if (!pDev)
        return SI5332_E_PARAM;
    if (!pDev->isConfigured)
        return SI5332_E_NOT_INIT;
    i = ch_index(ch);
    if (i < 0)
        return SI5332_E_PARAM;
    if (freq_hz < SI5332_FREQ_MIN_HZ || freq_hz > SI5332_FREQ_MAX_HZ)
        return SI5332_E_FREQ_UNSUPPORTED;

    cur = &pDev->ch[i];
    memcpy(tid, pDev->id, sizeof(tid));

    /* Release the previously used MultiSynth (only in the working copy) */
    if (cur->configured && (cur->src == SI5332_DIV_SRC_ID0 || cur->src == SI5332_DIV_SRC_ID1)) {
        id_state_t *old = &tid[cur->src == SI5332_DIV_SRC_ID0 ? 0 : 1];

        if (old->refcnt > 0 && --old->refcnt == 0) {
            old->num = 0;
            old->den = 0;
        }
    }

    if (try_hsdiv(freq_hz, HSDIV0_HZ, &r)) {
        src = SI5332_DIV_SRC_HSDIV0;
    } else if (try_hsdiv(freq_hz, HSDIV1_HZ, &r)) {
        src = SI5332_DIV_SRC_HSDIV1;
    } else {
        int sel = -1;

        /* 1. reuse an already used MultiSynth */
        for (int k = 0; k < NUM_ID; k++) {
            if (tid[k].refcnt > 0 && try_share_id(&tid[k], freq_hz, &r)) {
                sel = k;
                tid[k].refcnt++;
                break;
            }
        }
        /* 2. use a free MultiSynth */
        if (sel < 0) {
            u32 num, den;

            for (int k = 0; k < NUM_ID; k++) {
                if (tid[k].refcnt == 0) {
                    sel = k;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (sel < 0)
                return SI5332_E_NO_FREE_MS;
            {
                si5332_err_t e = plan_id(freq_hz, &num, &den, &r);
                if (e != SI5332_OK)
                    return e;
            }
            tid[sel].num    = num;
            tid[sel].den    = den;
            tid[sel].refcnt = 1;
        }
        src = (sel == 0) ? SI5332_DIV_SRC_ID0 : SI5332_DIV_SRC_ID1;
    }

    /* Success: adopt the working copy and mark changed IDs */
    for (int k = 0; k < NUM_ID; k++) {
        const id_state_t *o = &pDev->id[k];
        const id_state_t *n = &tid[k];

        if ((o->refcnt > 0) != (n->refcnt > 0) || o->num != n->num || o->den != n->den)
            pDev->dirty_id |= (u8)(1u << k);
    }
    memcpy(pDev->id, tid, sizeof(tid));

    cur->src        = src;
    cur->rdiv       = r;
    cur->freq_hz    = freq_hz;
    cur->configured = 1;
    pDev->dirty_ch |= (u8)(1u << i);

    return SI5332_OK;
}

si5332_err_t si5332_get_status(si5332_t *pDev, si5332_status_flags_t *flags)
{
    u8 stat, sts;

    if (!pDev || !flags)
        return SI5332_E_PARAM;
    if (!pDev->isReady)
        return SI5332_E_NOT_INIT;

    CHK(reg_read(pDev, REG_USYS_STAT, &stat));
    CHK(reg_read(pDev, REG_STATUS, &sts));

    flags->usys_stat    = stat;
    flags->is_active    = (stat == USYS_ACTIVE);
    flags->no_input     = (stat == USYS_NO_INPUT);
    flags->vdd_xtal_ok  = (sts >> 7) & 0x01;
    flags->vddo_ok_mask = sts & 0x3F;

    return SI5332_OK;
}

si5332_err_t si5332_apply_config(si5332_t *pDev)
{
    return si5332_init(pDev, SI5332_CLK_SRC_XTAL_27M);
}

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Concept: * Almost all output registers (OUTx_MODE, OUTx_DIV, ID dividers, input/PLL registers, power-down bits) are only writable in READY mode. Changes are therefore collected in the driver (si5332_set_output_format() / si5332_set_output_freq()) and applied with si5332_commit() in a single READY->ACTIVE cycle.

Warning:

Every commit briefly interrupts ALL outputs, including OUT6 (25 MHz).

  • OUT6 (25 MHz CMOS system clock) is fixed and cannot be changed via the API.
  • HSDIV0 (100 MHz) and HSDIV1 (125 MHz) are fixed; additional frequencies are generated via the two MultiSynths (ID0/ID1, fractional).

#include "si5332_cfg.h"

/* Public tables: documented in si5332_cfg.h only. */
const si5332_reg_t si5332_base_regs[] =
{
    /* Design ID "UNVBB1" */
    { 0x17, 0x55 },
    { 0x18, 0x4E },
    { 0x19, 0x56 },
    { 0x1A, 0x42 },
    { 0x1B, 0x42 },
    { 0x1C, 0x31 },

    /* Output muxes / HSDIV (O0 = 25 -> 100 MHz, O1 = 20 -> 125 MHz) */
    { 0x25, 0x00 }, /* OMUX0: HSDIV0 */
    { 0x27, 0x10 }, /* OMUX2: HSDIV1 */
    { 0x29, 0x00 }, /* OMUX4: HSDIV0 (OUT6) */
    { 0x2B, 0x19 }, /* HSDIV0A_DIV = 25 */
    { 0x2D, 0x14 }, /* HSDIV1A_DIV = 20 */

    /* Spread spectrum: off */
    { 0x3C, 0x00 },
    { 0x48, 0x00 },
    { 0x54, 0x00 },
    { 0x60, 0x00 },

    { 0x74, 0x00 }, /* CLKIN_3_CLK_SEL: off */

    /* OUT0: 100 MHz LVDS fast */
    { 0x7A, 0x06 },
    { 0x7B, 0x01 },
    { 0x7C, 0x00 },
    { 0x7D, 0x00 },
    /* OUT1: unused */
    { 0x7F, 0x07 },
    { 0x81, 0x00 },
    { 0x82, 0x00 },
    /* OUT2: 125 MHz LVDS fast */
    { 0x89, 0x06 },
    { 0x8A, 0x01 },
    { 0x8B, 0x00 },
    { 0x8C, 0x00 },
    /* OUT3: unused */
    { 0x8E, 0x07 },
    { 0x90, 0x00 },
    { 0x91, 0x00 },
    /* OUT4: unused (mode LVDS fast preset) */
    { 0x98, 0x06 },
    { 0x9A, 0x00 },
    { 0x9B, 0x00 },
    /* OUT5: unused */
    { 0x9D, 0x07 },
    { 0x9F, 0x00 },
    { 0xA0, 0x00 },
    /* OUT6: 25 MHz LVCMOS (HSDIV0 / R6 = 4), fixed */
    { 0xA7, 0x03 },
    { 0xA8, 0x04 },
    { 0xA9, 0x00 },
    { 0xAA, 0x00 },
    { 0xAB, 0x00 },
    /* OUT7: unused (mode LVDS fast preset) */
    { 0xAC, 0x06 },
    { 0xAE, 0x00 },
    { 0xAF, 0x00 },

    /* Output enable: OUT6 only */
    { 0xB6, 0x00 },
    { 0xB7, 0x02 },

    /* Power-down bits (OUT4, OUT7, OMUX3, OMUX5, ID0, ID1, HSDIV2..4 off) */
    { 0xBA, 0x7C },
    { 0xBB, 0x2A },
    { 0xBC, 0xD2 },
    { 0xBD, 0x04 },

    { 0xBF, 0x00 }, /* XOSC_CINT_ENA */
};
const u32 si5332_base_regs_len = ARRAY_LEN(si5332_base_regs);

const si5332_reg_t si5332_src_xtal_27m_regs[] =
{
    { 0x24, 0x01 }, /* IMUX_SEL = XOSC */
    /* IDPA: feedback divider M = 2500/27, big-endian 15 bit */
    { 0x67, 0x2E }, { 0x68, 0x4B }, /* IDPA_INTG = 11851 */
    { 0x69, 0x00 }, { 0x6A, 0x17 }, /* IDPA_RES  = 23 */
    { 0x6B, 0x00 }, { 0x6C, 0x1B }, /* IDPA_DEN  = 27 */
    { 0x73, 0x00 }, /* CLKIN_2_CLK_SEL = off */
    { 0x75, 0x01 }, /* P_VAL = 1 */
    { 0xB9, 0x06 }, /* XOSC on, IBUF0/IBUF1 off */
    { 0xBE, 0x10 }, /* PLL_MODE (loop BW for Fpfd 27 MHz) */
    { 0xC0, 0x1B }, /* XOSC_CTRIM_XIN */
    { 0xC1, 0x1B }, /* XOSC_CTRIM_XOUT */
};

    { 0x69, 0x00 }, { 0x6A, 0x00 }, /* IDPA_RES  = 0 */
    { 0x6B, 0x00 }, { 0x6C, 0x01 }, /* IDPA_DEN  = 1 */
    { 0x73, 0x01 }, /* CLKIN_2_CLK_SEL = differential */
    { 0x75, 0x02 }, /* P_VAL = 2 */
    { 0xB9, 0x05 }, /* XOSC off, IBUF0 on, IBUF1 off */
    { 0xBE, 0x20 }, /* PLL_MODE (loop BW for Fpfd 50 MHz) */
    { 0xC0, 0x00 }, /* XOSC_CTRIM_XIN */
    { 0xC1, 0x00 }, /* XOSC_CTRIM_XOUT */
};
const u32 si5332_src_clkin2_100m_regs_len = ARRAY_LEN(si5332_src_clkin2_100m_regs);

#include "tpsm8286x.h"
#include "userDef.h"    /* provides TPSM8286_NUM_OF_INSTANCES */


typedef struct {
    float   min_volt;      
    float   max_volt;      
    float   step_volt;     
    u8 reg_min;     
    u8 reg_max;     
} tpsm8286_voltage_map_t;

struct tpsm8286_t {
    u8 isReady; 
    u8 control; 
    u8 status;  
    u8 isEnabled;   
    float voltage;  
    u8 voltage_raw; 
    u8 i2cAddr; 
    void* hal_ctx;  
    tpsm8286_i2c_write_f i2c_write; 
    tpsm8286_i2c_read_f i2c_read;   
};

const tpsm8286_voltage_map_t TPSM8286_VOLTAGEMAP_10MV = {
    .min_volt = 0.800f, .max_volt = 3.350f, .step_volt = 0.01f,
    .reg_min = 0x00, .reg_max = 0xFF
};

static tpsm8286_t gInstances[TPSM8286_NUM_OF_INSTANCES];

static inline float clampf(float x, float a, float b) { return (x < a) ? a : (x > b) ? b : x; }



/* Public API: documented in tpsm8286x.h only. */
tpsm8286_t* tpsm8286_initialize(u32 devId, u8 i2c_addr, tpsm8286_i2c_write_f w, tpsm8286_i2c_read_f r, void *ctx )
{
    tpsm8286_t* pInst = &gInstances[devId];

    pInst->i2cAddr = i2c_addr;
    pInst->i2c_write = w;
    pInst->i2c_read = r;
    pInst->hal_ctx = ctx;
    pInst->control = 0;
    pInst->status = 0;
    pInst->voltage = 0.0f;
    pInst->voltage_raw = 0;
    pInst->isEnabled = 0;
    pInst->isReady = 1;

    return pInst;
}


tpsm8286_err_t tpsm8286_voltage_to_reg(float voltage, u8 *reg_out) {
    if (!reg_out) return TPSM8286_E_PARAM;
    tpsm8286_voltage_map_t m = TPSM8286_VOLTAGEMAP_10MV;
    float volt_c = clampf(voltage, m.min_volt, m.max_volt);
    float steps = (volt_c - m.min_volt) / m.step_volt;
    if (steps < 0) steps = 0;
    float steps_max = (m.max_volt - m.min_volt) / m.step_volt;
    if (steps > steps_max) steps = steps_max;

    /* Map steps to register range */
    float span = (float)((int)m.reg_max - (int)m.reg_min);
    u8 reg = (u8)((m.reg_min) + (steps / steps_max) * span + 0.5f);
    *reg_out = reg;
    return TPSM8286_OK;
}

tpsm8286_err_t tpsm8286_set_voltage(tpsm8286_t *pDev, float voltage)
{
    if (!pDev) return TPSM8286_E_PARAM;
    tpsm8286_err_t status;

    status = tpsm8286_voltage_to_reg(voltage,&pDev->voltage_raw);
    if(status != 0) return TPSM8286_E_I2C;

    pDev->voltage = voltage;

    status = pDev->i2c_write(pDev->hal_ctx, pDev->i2cAddr, TPSM8286_VOUT1_REG_ADDR, &pDev->voltage_raw);

    return status;
}

tpsm8286_err_t tpsm8286_check_voltageReg(tpsm8286_t *pDev, int *regOk)
{
    if (!pDev) return TPSM8286_E_PARAM;
    tpsm8286_err_t status;
    u8 regVal;

    status = pDev->i2c_read(pDev->hal_ctx, pDev->i2cAddr, TPSM8286_VOUT1_REG_ADDR, &regVal);
    if(status != TPSM8286_OK) return TPSM8286_E_I2C;

    *regOk = (regVal == pDev->voltage_raw) ? 1 : 0;

    return status;
}


tpsm8286_err_t tpsm8286_set_cntrl(tpsm8286_t *pDev, u8 regVal)
{
    if (!pDev) return TPSM8286_E_PARAM;
    tpsm8286_err_t status;

    status = pDev->i2c_write(pDev->hal_ctx, pDev->i2cAddr, TPSM8286_CNTRL_REG_ADDR, &regVal);

    return status;
}

tpsm8286_err_t tpsm8286_set_enable(tpsm8286_t *pDev, int enable)
{
    if (!pDev) return TPSM8286_E_PARAM;
    tpsm8286_err_t status;
    u8 regVal;

    enable = enable != 0 ? TPSM8286_DEVICE_ENABLE_MASK : 0;

    status = pDev->i2c_read(pDev->hal_ctx, pDev->i2cAddr, TPSM8286_CNTRL_REG_ADDR, &regVal);
    if(status != 0) return TPSM8286_E_I2C;

    regVal = (regVal & ~TPSM8286_DEVICE_ENABLE_MASK) | enable;

    status = pDev->i2c_write(pDev->hal_ctx, pDev->i2cAddr, TPSM8286_CNTRL_REG_ADDR, &regVal);

    return status;
}

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Bus-agnostic core driver: it only uses injected HAL callbacks (tpsm8286_i2c_write_f / tpsm8286_i2c_read_f), never a concrete I2C driver directly. The callback signatures match i2c_writeReg()/i2c_readReg() in drivers/i2c/i2cWrapper.h, so they can be passed directly via a function-pointer cast.

Multiple simultaneous instances are supported: tpsm8286_initialize() takes an explicit devId that indexes the static instance pool (size TPSM8286_NUM_OF_INSTANCES, defined in userDef.h).

docs.title: function tpsm8286_set_voltage
docs.text:
Sets the output voltage setpoint (VOUT1 register). 

tpsm8286_err_t tpsm8286_set_voltage (
    tpsm8286_t * pDev,
    float voltage
)

The voltage is mapped to the 10 mV/LSB register scale and clamped to the supported range (0.8 V .. 3.35 V). Takes effect according to the configured ramp speed; the output enable state is not changed.

Parameters:

  • pDev Device handle.
  • voltage Desired output voltage [V].

Returns:

TPSM8286_OK on success, TPSM8286_E_PARAM if pDev is NULL, TPSM8286_E_I2C on a HAL/bus error.

// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

#include "i2cWrapper.h"
#include "userDef.h"
#include "bsp.h"

#define DEFAULT_TIMEOUT 100000  

struct i2cHandle_t
{
    u8 deviceId;        
    u32 baseAddress;    
    u8 intrId;      
    u8 intrPrio;        
    u8 intrHart;        
    I2c_Config cfg;     

    /* Error flags set asynchronously by the ISR */
    volatile u8 timeout;      
    volatile u8 arbLoss;      
    volatile u8 nackRecvd;    
};

static i2cHandle_t gI2cInstances[I2C_NUM_OF_INSTANCES];

static void i2c_isr();





static int i2c_txNackWithEC(i2cHandle_t *pInst){
    i2c_txNack(pInst->baseAddress);

    while(read_u32(pInst->baseAddress + I2C_TX_ACK) & I2C_TX_VALID) 
    {
        if (pInst->timeout) {
            return I2C_WRAPPER_TIMEOUT;
        }
        if (pInst->arbLoss) {
            return I2C_WRAPPER_ARB_LOSS;
        }       
    }
    return I2C_WRAPPER_OK;
}

static int i2c_txAckWithEC(i2cHandle_t *pInst){
    i2c_txAck(pInst->baseAddress);

    while(read_u32(pInst->baseAddress + I2C_TX_ACK) & I2C_TX_VALID) 
    {
        if (pInst->timeout) {
            return I2C_WRAPPER_TIMEOUT;
        }
        if (pInst->arbLoss) {
            return I2C_WRAPPER_ARB_LOSS;
        }       
    }
    return I2C_WRAPPER_OK;
}

static int i2c_rxAckWaitWithEC(i2cHandle_t *pInst){
    while ((read_u32(pInst->baseAddress + I2C_RX_ACK) & I2C_RX_VALUE) != 0)
    {
        if (pInst->timeout) {
        return I2C_WRAPPER_TIMEOUT;
        }
        if (pInst->arbLoss) {
            return I2C_WRAPPER_ARB_LOSS;
        }     
    }
    return I2C_WRAPPER_OK;
}



static int i2c_masterStartWithEC(i2cHandle_t *pInst) {
    i2c_masterStart(pInst->baseAddress);

    // Reset timeout flags
    pInst->timeout = 0;
    pInst->arbLoss = 0;

    // Poll with error check
    while(i2c_getMasterStatus(pInst->baseAddress) & I2C_MASTER_START) {
        if (pInst->timeout) {
            return I2C_WRAPPER_TIMEOUT;
        }
        if (pInst->arbLoss) {
            return I2C_WRAPPER_ARB_LOSS;
        }        
    }
    return I2C_WRAPPER_OK;
}

static int i2c_masterStopWithEC(i2cHandle_t *pInst) {
    i2c_masterStop(pInst->baseAddress);

    // Reset timeout flags
    pInst->timeout = 0;
    pInst->arbLoss = 0;

    // Poll with error check
    while(i2c_getMasterStatus(pInst->baseAddress) & I2C_MASTER_STOP) {
        if (pInst->timeout) {
            return I2C_WRAPPER_TIMEOUT;
        }
        if (pInst->arbLoss) {
            return I2C_WRAPPER_ARB_LOSS;
        }       
    }
    return I2C_WRAPPER_OK;
}

static int TX_AND_CHECK_WITH_EC(i2cHandle_t *pInst, u8 byte) {
    int result;

    i2c_txByte(pInst->baseAddress, byte);

    result = i2c_txNackWithEC(pInst);  
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        return result;
    }
    i2c_rxAckWaitWithEC(pInst);     
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        return result;
    }
    return I2C_WRAPPER_OK;
}


/* Public API: documented in i2cWrapper.h only. */
i2cHandle_t* i2c_initialize(i2cHandle_config_t *pDevCfg, intrHandle_t *pIntr)
{
    i2cHandle_t *pInst = &gI2cInstances[pDevCfg->deviceId];

    pInst->baseAddress              = pDevCfg->baseAddress;
    pInst->deviceId                 = pDevCfg->deviceId;
    pInst->intrHart                 = pDevCfg->intrHart;
    pInst->intrId                   = pDevCfg->intrId;
    pInst->intrPrio                 = pDevCfg->intrPrio;
    pInst->cfg.samplingClockDivider = pDevCfg->cfg.samplingClockDivider;
    pInst->cfg.tBuf                 = pDevCfg->cfg.tBuf;
    pInst->cfg.tHigh                = pDevCfg->cfg.tHigh;
    pInst->cfg.tLow                 = pDevCfg->cfg.tLow;
    pInst->cfg.timeout              = pDevCfg->cfg.timeout;
    pInst->cfg.tsuDat               = pDevCfg->cfg.tsuDat;

    // Initialize timeout-related fields
    pInst->timeout = 0;
    pInst->arbLoss = 0;
    pInst->nackRecvd = 0;   

    i2c_applyConfig(pInst->baseAddress, &pInst->cfg);

    intr_connect(pIntr, pInst->intrId, &i2c_isr, pInst);

    //enable PLIC I2C interrupts
    intr_setPriority(pIntr, pInst->intrId, pInst->intrPrio);
    intr_setEnable(pIntr, pInst->intrHart, pInst->intrId);

    i2c_enableInterrupt(pInst->baseAddress, I2C_INTERRUPT_DROP);

    return pInst;
}

int i2c_writeRegMultipleBytes(i2cHandle_t *pInst, u8 slaveAddr, u8 regAddr, u8 *data, u32 length) {
    int result;

    // Start condition
    result = i2c_masterStartWithEC(pInst);
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        return result;
    }

    // Send slave address with write bit
    result = TX_AND_CHECK_WITH_EC(pInst, ((slaveAddr<<1) | I2C_WRITE));
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        i2c_masterStop(pInst->baseAddress);  // Clean up
        return result;
    }

    // Send register address
    result = TX_AND_CHECK_WITH_EC(pInst, regAddr);
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        i2c_masterStop(pInst->baseAddress);  
        return result;
    }

    // Send data
    for(u32 i = 0; i < length; i++){
        result = TX_AND_CHECK_WITH_EC(pInst, data[i]);
        if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
            i2c_masterStop(pInst->baseAddress);  
        }
    }

    i2c_masterStopWithEC(pInst);
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        return result;
    }
    return I2C_WRAPPER_OK;
}

int i2c_readRegMultipleBytes(i2cHandle_t *pInst, u8 slaveAddr, u8 regAddr, u8 *data, u32 length) {
    int result;     

    // Start condition
    result = i2c_masterStartWithEC(pInst);
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        return result;
    }

    // Send slave address with write bit
    result = TX_AND_CHECK_WITH_EC(pInst, ((slaveAddr<<1) | I2C_WRITE));
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        i2c_masterStop(pInst->baseAddress);  // Clean up
        return result;
    }

    // Send register address
    result = TX_AND_CHECK_WITH_EC(pInst, regAddr);
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        i2c_masterStop(pInst->baseAddress);  // Clean up
        return result;
    }

    // Repeated start condition
    result = i2c_masterStartWithEC(pInst);
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        return result;
    }

    // Send slave address with read bit
    result = TX_AND_CHECK_WITH_EC(pInst, ((slaveAddr<<1) | I2C_READ));
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        i2c_masterStop(pInst->baseAddress);  // Clean up
        return result;
    }

    if(length > 1){
        for(u32 i = 0; i < length - 1; i++){
            i2c_txByte(pInst->baseAddress, 0xFF);
            result = i2c_txAckWithEC(pInst);
            if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
                i2c_masterStop(pInst->baseAddress);  // Clean up
                return result;
            }
            data[i] = i2c_rxData(pInst->baseAddress);
        }
    }

    i2c_txByte(pInst->baseAddress, 0xFF);
    result = i2c_txNackWithEC(pInst);
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        i2c_masterStop(pInst->baseAddress);  // Clean up
        return result;
    }
    data[length-1] = i2c_rxData(pInst->baseAddress);

    result = i2c_masterStopWithEC(pInst);
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        return result;
    }
    return I2C_WRAPPER_OK;
}

int i2c_writeReg(i2cHandle_t *pInst, u8 slaveAddr, u8 regAddr, u8 *data) {

    return i2c_writeRegMultipleBytes(pInst, slaveAddr, regAddr, data, 0x1);
}


int i2c_readReg(i2cHandle_t *pInst, u8 slaveAddr, u8 regAddr, u8 *data) {

    return i2c_readRegMultipleBytes(pInst, slaveAddr, regAddr, data, 0x1);
}

int i2c_write(i2cHandle_t *pInst, u8 slaveAddr, u8 *data, u32 length) {
    int result;

    // Start condition
    result = i2c_masterStartWithEC(pInst);
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        return result;
    }

    // Send slave address with write bit
    result = TX_AND_CHECK_WITH_EC(pInst, ((slaveAddr<<1) | I2C_WRITE));
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        i2c_masterStop(pInst->baseAddress);  // Clean up
        return result;
    }

    // Send data
    for(u32 i = 0; i < length; i++){
        result = TX_AND_CHECK_WITH_EC(pInst, data[i]);
        if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
            i2c_masterStop(pInst->baseAddress);  // Clean up
            return result;
        }
    }

    result = i2c_masterStopWithEC(pInst);
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        return result;
    }
    return I2C_WRAPPER_OK;
}


int i2c_read(i2cHandle_t *pInst, u8 slaveAddr, u8 *data, u32 length) {
    int result;

    // Start condition
    result = i2c_masterStartWithEC(pInst);
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        return result;
    }

    // Send slave address with read bit
    result = TX_AND_CHECK_WITH_EC(pInst, ((slaveAddr<<1) | I2C_READ));
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        i2c_masterStop(pInst->baseAddress);  // Clean up
        return result;
    }

    if(length > 1){
        for(u32 i = 0; i < length - 1; i++){
            i2c_txByte(pInst->baseAddress, 0xFF);
            result = i2c_txAckWithEC(pInst);
            if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
                i2c_masterStop(pInst->baseAddress);  // Clean up
                return result;
            }
            data[i] = i2c_rxData(pInst->baseAddress);
        }
    }

    i2c_txByte(pInst->baseAddress, 0xFF);
    result = i2c_txNackWithEC(pInst);
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        i2c_masterStop(pInst->baseAddress);  // Clean up
        return result;
    }
    data[length-1] = i2c_rxData(pInst->baseAddress);

    result = i2c_masterStopWithEC(pInst);
    if (result != I2C_WRAPPER_OK) {
        return result;
    }
    return I2C_WRAPPER_OK;
}

static void i2c_isr(void *callBackRef){
    i2cHandle_t *pInst = (i2cHandle_t*)callBackRef;
    u32 interruptFlags = i2c_getInterruptFlag(pInst->baseAddress);

    // Check for drop interrupt (timeout)
    if (interruptFlags & I2C_INTERRUPT_DROP) {
        pInst->timeout = 1;
        bsp_printf("I2C timeout detected!\r\n");
    }

    // Check for arbitration loss
    if (interruptFlags & I2C_MASTER_START_DROPPED) {
        pInst->arbLoss = 1;
        bsp_printf("I2C arbitration loss detected!\r\n");
    }

    // Clear all interrupt flags
    i2c_clearInterruptFlag(pInst->baseAddress, interruptFlags);
}
